name: Posture corrector brace
lead: A posture corrector brace is a strap or harness worn across the shoulders and upper back that pulls the shoulders back. It is sold to fix rounded shoulders and slouching.
It appears in posture and presence discussions as a quick cosmetic fix, and is typically treated there as a reminder tool at best.

paras: The straps mechanically hold the shoulders in retraction while worn and give sensory feedback when the user slumps. Research on posture-correcting garments and devices shows posture changes while worn, but little evidence that wearing them leads to lasting changes in muscle strength or resting alignment. Strengthening and motor control training of the upper back muscles is the better-supported route.

Prolonged use may encourage reliance on the brace, and tight straps can irritate the skin, compress nerves in the armpit or cause discomfort. A scoping review concluded that posture-correcting shirts for musculoskeletal pain are not supported by current evidence. The marketing claim of permanent correction is unsupported.

studies.title: Posture-correcting shirts for musculoskeletal pain: a scoping review
Wearable posture devices: systematic review (Caixeiro et al.)
